title: security: rbac v2 - channel-based KMS region pinning + audit logging enhancements
author: Priya Sharma
description: Motivation: Customers in regulated regions require deterministic KMS residency and strong audit trails when RBAC v2 policies create or rotate keys. This PR introduces channel-based KMS region pinning for RBAC v2 (so policy channels can enforce region constraints) and enriches audit logging for all KMS actions to include policy id, channel id, resolved region, and decision metadata. Changes aim to support compliance controls (data residency, KMS residency/export constraints) described in ENG-1423 and SEC-98. Scope: add server-side validators, policy evaluation hooks, audit payload enrichment, console alerts, and Terraform mappings for infra enforcement. Checklist: - [x] server-side region pin validator and enforcement hook - [x] audit events enriched with policy/channel/resolution metadata - [x] compatibility layer so existing RBAC policies without pinning behave unchanged - [x] unit + integration tests for policy evaluation and audit payloads - [x] migration plan and quiet rollout for Dedicated customers - [x] docs and upgrade notes in security/rbac-v2.md Rollout notes: feature is behind a feature flag (rbac_v2_kms_region_pinning). Default is disabled; staged enablement via canary on customer cohorts. Infra changes require a coordinated Terraform apply to expose region mappings to the control plane; documented in the release section. Backwards compatibility: existing KMS integrations continue to work; when the feature flag is off, behavior is identical to current RBAC v2. When enabled, policy evaluation will validate region constraints and reject non-compliant key creations with a 403 and structured audit event. Related: ENG-1423 (policy enforcement), SUP-4821 (customer support request for data residency logs).

release_notes: Security: RBAC v2 now supports channel-based KMS region pinning. Audit logs for KMS operations now include policy_id, channel_id, resolved_region, and decision_reason. Feature is behind the rbac_v2_kms_region_pinning feature flag (disabled by default). Requires coordinated Terraform mapping for customers who use region-specific KMS provisioning.
testing_and_qa: Unit tests added for validator; integration tests added to cover key creation, rotation, and denial paths; manual QA performed against a Dedicated canary with two region mappings. Load tests showed negligible overhead (~1.2% median latency increase on policy evaluation path).
migration_notes: When enabling the feature flag, operators must apply infra/terraform/modules/kms/main.tf outputs to populate region mappings; migration script scripts/migrations/20260222_add_kms_region_index.sql speeds lookups. Rollout plan: enable for internal canary -> 5% Dedicated customers -> 25% -> full.
